$comment: Phase 19 (0.1.7) Task 0 performance-and-dx scope gate. Machine-checkable source of truth consumed by Tasks 1-6 of plans/019-Release-0-1-7-Performance-and-DX.md: the four roadmap 0.1.7 items (prompt-cache telemetry surface per provider; model-router cost/latency-aware selection policy + fallback chains; async AgUiProjection hooks closeout — verification-only, shipped 0.0.26 Task 15; `prism providers add <name>` scaffold) each with an allowed-file scope and task ownership, the preserved surface that must stay byte-identical for the whole phase (cache-helpers math, cli-init machinery, usage event shape, memory router state), allowed/forbidden changes, the additive-only compat promise (no --allow-break; regeneration only after a clean plain gate at 0.1.7 proves 0 breaking deltas), the audit/signed-tag/provenance policy, per-task evidence tokens, and the deviation log. This is a scope gate, NOT a release-contract support matrix; the 0.1.x support matrix stays frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json and 0.1.7 changes none of it. Amendment requires a recorded deviation entry below. Validated by scripts/phase19-freeze.test.mjs. Baseline evidence for regression comparison at the Task 6 exit gate lives in scripts/phase19-baseline.json.
baseline: 0.1.6 (plan 018 exit gate passed 2026-08-11; signed tag v0.1.6; 50 publishable manifests; audit 0 moderate; compat baselines current at 0.1.6)

items.title: Prompt-cache telemetry surface per provider (hit/miss, cache tokens)
items.rationale: roadmap 0.1.7 item 1 / Performance opportunities (a): hosts need per-provider hit/miss + cache-token aggregation to tune the cache_aware input layout; builds on Usage.cacheReadTokens/cacheWriteTokens + cacheHitRate/cacheSavings/cacheUsageReport, which stay untouched (preserved surface).

items.title: Model-router cost/latency-aware selection policy + fallback chains
items.rationale: roadmap 0.1.7 item 2 / Performance opportunities (b): router state is durable since Phase 6 but candidate ordering is fixed (primary + ordered fallbacks); make selection host-configurable with a reference cost/latency policy, default behavior byte-identical; no ModelRouterStateStore or Postgres store contract change.

items.title: Async AgUiProjection hooks verification (plan 008 closeout; no new code expected)
items.rationale: roadmap 0.1.7 item 3 / plan 008 further action: the Awaitable<T> hook surface + async getMessages already shipped in 0.0.26 Task 15 (projection.ts, projectors.ts, ag-ui-mapper.ts, docs/ag-ui.md); this item verifies and records evidence; the allowed file is the tentative regression-test landing spot, used ONLY if verification finds a gap (baseline.asyncHooks.gapFound).

items.title: prism providers add <name> scaffold (DX)
items.rationale: roadmap 0.1.7 item 4 / Setup and structure improvements: generate an OpenAI-compatible provider package from a template (manifest, provider.ts, models.ts, cache.ts, conformance test, docs/providers/<name>.md); reuses the cli-init template/catalog/force patterns, which stay untouched (preserved surface).

preservedSurface.rule: These files implement the primitives 0.1.7 reuses (cache math, usage event, init machinery, router memory state). They are byte-immutable for the whole phase; a hash mismatch fails loud at any task state. Deviations require a recorded entry.

files.src/cache-helpers.ts: cacheHitRate/cacheSavings/cacheUsageReport math is reused by cache-telemetry, not reimplemented
files.src/provider-events.ts: usage ProviderEvent shape unchanged; telemetry consumes it
files.src/cli-init.ts: init template/catalog/force patterns are reused by the provider scaffold, not edited
files.packages/model-router/src/state.ts: memory state store contract unchanged; selection policy never bypasses allow-list/residency/budget decisions

tasks.$comment: per-task evidence tokens; 'done' when the task passes its checks, 'pending' until then. Task 0 sets itself done at freeze; Tasks 1-5 move to done as they land; Task 6 (docs, changelog, bump, exit gate) lands last. security.blockedGatePolicy: missing credentials or infrastructure records a named blocked release gate, never a passing skip (inherited from scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json)
security.auditPolicy: npm audit --audit-level=moderate stays at 0 moderate-or-higher findings at 0.1.7
security.itemPolicy: every shipped item preserves: explicit activation (cache telemetry aggregates only when the host wires it; selection policy applies only when the host configures it; the scaffold writes only to the host-chosen directory), redaction-safe reports and diagnostics (no prompt content, cache keys, identity fields, or latency samples leave through telemetry/report paths), fail-closed validation (scaffold name/path/env-key refusals before any write), and unchanged deny-by-default governance (a selection policy can never widen allow-list/residency/budget decisions); adversarial suites for each shipped item pass before its task token flips to done; publication stays operator-gated
